stateChanges: GameState now includes tileHazards and debuffs.

hazards.unlock: 180 lifetime Grass Touches and at least 8 field tiles
hazards.behavior: Spawns temporarily on grown tiles. Touching it removes the cactus, stops persistent touch, applies Pricked, and plays prick feedback.
hazards.debuff: Pricked lasts 8500 ms normally or 5200 ms with Garden Gloves. It applies grassTouchMultiplier x0.82 and comboWindowMultiplier x0.92, and adds +55 ms to Persistent Touch interval.

hazards.unlock: 360 lifetime Grass Touches and at least 16 field tiles
hazards.behavior: Spawns temporarily on grown tiles and can spread to cardinal neighbors. Touching weeds pulls them instead of touching grass; strength is usually 1 or 2.
hazards.counterplay: Garden Gloves makes new weeds usually strength 1. Compost Bin can turn cleared weeds into a seed reward.

hazards.unlock: 720 lifetime Grass Touches and at least 28 field tiles
hazards.behavior: Creates an animated route across existing field tiles. Crossed grown tiles become regrowing/mown. It clears cactus and weeds on the route.
hazards.counterplay: Mower Boundary increases interval by x1.35 and caps route length at 9 instead of 14. Compost Bin improves mown tile recovery with regrow scale 0.92 instead of default 1.16.

otherGameplayChanges: FieldSystem gained setTileRegrowing helper and tracks regrowing tiles consistently.
UpgradeSystem applies Pricked debuff when computing RuntimeStats.
AudioSystem includes procedural prick and mower sounds.
GameScene renders hazard overlays for live/batch tiles, handles hazard touches before normal tile touches, animates mower movement, shows hazard HUD/status text, and creates hazard textures.
Seed Shop data includes Garden Gloves and Mower Boundary. Compost Bin text/behavior now includes mower recovery and weed compost support.

created.description: Comprehensive systems reference for brainstorming and coherence work. Includes architecture diagrams, progression loop, update loop, GameState map, touch formulas, tile/trait/tier behavior, RuntimeStats, upgrades, shops, automation, weather, journal, quests, mutations, hazards, prestige, save/performance notes, coherence notes, and future brainstorming hooks.
created.verification: 1424 lines, 56832 characters, ASCII-clean, no TODO/FIXME markers.

notableCoherenceNotesAdded: Dewy/lush trait value mismatch: UI suggests dewy/lush add direct value, but touch formula only gives lush +1 direct touch value and dewy probability bonuses.
Automation has two parallel fantasies: passive route/shift/crew systems and gold-store individual companions.

Sprinkler has three meanings: seed shop blueprint, automation-store unit, active/placeable helper. Active SprinklerSystem currently keys off Seed Shop blueprint rather than owned automation unit count.
Passive AutomationIncomeSystem may double-count actions: it calls recordAutomationAction and then recordAutomationTouch, which also records an action.
Seeds mostly unlock rules/systems while gold buys tangible consumables/companions.
Hazards could use more reward texture in future design.
